{"consolidated_memory":"SEARCH/QUERY/REWRITER.TS: SERIES OF SIX EMPTY RESULT SET INCIDENTS (2026-02-11 through 2026-05-30)

All six occasions involved the same problem (empty result set in the query rewriter), same signal (a rewritten query with no clauses left), same reproduction case (search for a two word phrase with a stop word), and same test file (search/query/rewriter.test.ts). Each occasion had a distinct trigger, root cause, and fix.

OCCASION 1: 2026-02-11
Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR #1626 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
Result: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 18 days running

OCCASION 2: 2026-02-13
Trigger: Only when the input list came in empty
Root cause: An N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
PR #2974 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
Result: Memory settled at 587 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB

OCCASION 3: 2026-02-21
Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: An error swallowed by a bare except
Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
PR #3013 on branch fix/empty-result-set-3
Result: Cold start dropped 2 percent, to 413 ms

OCCASION 4: 2026-03-16
Trigger: Only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
Root cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR #3381 on branch fix/empty-result-set-4
Result: Error rate dropped from 5.9 percent to under 5 per ten thousand

OCCASION 5: 2026-05-10
Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR #6945 on branch fix/empty-result-set-5
Result: Flaky test went from 31 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 6: 2026-05-30
Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
PR #7342 on branch fix/empty-result-set-6
Result: 49 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

Common context: All work in search/query/rewriter.ts on the search side; TypeScript stack."}
